global.description: Platform values (global.okdp): the context's layers, the platform's (platform.yaml) then its project's (project.yaml), never an instance's.

imageTag.title: Image tag
imageTag.description: Server image tag. Set explicitly so the deployed image is pinned; empty, the upstream half of the package version.

consoleHost.title: Console host
consoleHost.description: Console host, used verbatim as the single allowed origin. Defaults to okdp-ui.<ingress suffix>.

insecureOciRegistries.title: Insecure OCI registries
insecureOciRegistries.description: Registry hosts reachable over plain HTTP, comma separated. A sandbox concern, empty anywhere else.

gitops.title: Deployments repositories
gitops.description: The Git repositories the server commits the desired state to, their topology (the platform's, the projects' and the output's), and the engine reconciling them.

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: Required: where the platform, the projects and the compiled output live, each a repository (url, branch, path; the projects' url and path may hold {project}), the output in a repository of its own, never the platform's nor a project's, and the Forgejo the server creates the project repositories in (split topology). Written to a ConfigMap mounted at /etc/okdp/gitops/topology.yaml (GITOPS_CONFIG), forgejo.tokenFile set to the token of forgejoTokenSecret. The server has no single-repository mode: repoURL, branch and path are gone.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: The platform's sources: platform.yaml, catalogs.yaml, and projects.yaml in the split topology.

path.description: The directory of the repository, empty for its root.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Each project's sources (project.yaml, instances/): {project} in url or path is the project's name; in the io topology, the platform's repository, path projects/{project}.

path.description: The directory of the repository, empty for its root.

output.title: Output
output.description: The compiled tree, compiled/ (and argocd/root.yaml): what Flux and Argo CD read, written by the CI of its repository only, a repository of its own.

path.description: The directory of the repository, empty for its root.

forgejo.title: Forgejo
forgejo.description: The Forgejo the server creates a new project's repository okdp-project-<project> in (split topology); its token is the key token of forgejoTokenSecret.

url.description: The Forgejo API base URL, e.g. http://forgejo-http.forgejo.svc.cluster.local:3000.

forgejoTokenSecret.title: Forgejo token secret
forgejoTokenSecret.description: Secret of the release namespace whose key token is the Forgejo API token, mounted at /etc/okdp/forgejo/token. Required with topology.forgejo.

chartCacheDir.title: Chart cache directory
chartCacheDir.description: Where the server pulls the upstream charts it checks the compiled values against (GITOPS_CHART_CACHE_DIR), an emptyDir. Empty: the server's default, under its clone.

releasesNamespace.title: Releases namespace
releasesNamespace.description: Namespace of the Flux HelmReleases, whose status the server reads there (the Role <release>-engine, engine flux).

argocdNamespace.title: Argo CD namespace
argocdNamespace.description: Namespace of the Argo CD Applications, whose status the server reads there (the Role <release>-engine, engine argocd).

credentialsSecret.title: Credentials secret
credentialsSecret.description: Secret with write access to the repositories of the sources and read access to the output's (Flux GitRepository keys: username/password, bearerToken, or identity/known_hosts).

insecureHTTPHosts.title: Plain-HTTP hosts
insecureHTTPHosts.description: Hosts a credential (the repositories', the catalogs', the Forgejo token) is sent to over http://, in clear (GITOPS_INSECURE_HTTP_HOSTS): host names, or globs of them (path.Match). None by default: every credential for an http:// URL is refused. Name the exact hosts, e.g. a sandbox's in-cluster Forgejo, forgejo-http.forgejo.svc.cluster.local; a glob such as *.svc.cluster.local trusts every Service of the cluster.

keycloak.title: Keycloak user management
keycloak.description: Keycloak Admin REST API backing the console's user and group management. Off while credentialsSecret.name is empty. The service account needs the realm-management roles view-users, query-users, manage-users and query-groups.

url.title: Keycloak URL
url.description: Base URL, without /realms/... (KEYCLOAK_URL). Empty: derived from the platform OIDC issuer.

realm.title: Realm
realm.description: Realm of the Admin API (KEYCLOAK_REALM). Empty: derived from the platform OIDC issuer.

credentialsSecret.title: Credentials secret
credentialsSecret.description: Secret in the release namespace with the service-account client credentials. The default keys match identity.provisioning.keycloak.credentialsSecret, so the same Secret can be reused.

tlsInsecure.title: Skip the TLS check
tlsInsecure.description: Skip the Keycloak certificate check (KEYCLOAK_TLS_INSECURE). Sandboxes only.

oidc.title: Console tokens
oidc.description: The verification of the console's tokens; the issuer and the client are the platform's (global.okdp.identity.oidc, else global.okdp.oidc).

groupsClaim.title: Groups claim
groupsClaim.description: The claim of the token holding the caller's groups (OIDC_GROUPS_CLAIM), a list of group names: Keycloak's groups mapper with Full group path off, the names global.okdp.access.admins and a project's access give. A dotted name is a nested claim.

tls.title: CA bundle
tls.description: The CA bundle every TLS client of the server trusts beside the system's (OIDC, Keycloak, Trino, the SQL editor, Forgejo, Git), mounted at /etc/okdp/ca (OKDP_CA_FILE).

caBundleSecret.title: CA bundle secret
caBundleSecret.description: A Secret of the release namespace holding the CA bundle. Empty: the platform's, global.okdp.tls.caBundleSecret (none when it is unset).

caBundleKey.title: CA bundle key
caBundleKey.description: The key of the bundle (PEM) in that Secret.

sqlEditor.title: SQL editor
sqlEditor.description: The bounds of the SQL editor and of the connection tests (SQL_*).

allowedNetworks.title: Allowed networks
allowedNetworks.description: Networks (CIDRs or addresses) the editor and the connection tests may reach although they are loopback, link-local (169.254.0.0/16, fe80::/10) or the Kubernetes API server, all refused otherwise (SQL_ALLOWED_NETWORKS).

statementTimeout.title: Statement timeout
statementTimeout.description: One statement's timeout, a Go duration, PostgreSQL's statement_timeout too (SQL_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT).

defaultRows.title: Default rows
defaultRows.description: The row cap of a request that names none (SQL_DEFAULT_ROWS).

maxRows.title: Maximum rows
maxRows.description: The largest row cap a request may ask (SQL_MAX_ROWS).

maxResultBytes.title: Maximum result bytes
maxResultBytes.description: Past this size of a result's rows, the rest is dropped, the result truncated (SQL_MAX_RESULT_BYTES).

maxConcurrentPerUser.title: Statements per user
maxConcurrentPerUser.description: Statements one user runs at once; past it, 429 (SQL_MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_USER).

tokenExchangeAudience.title: Token exchange audience
tokenExchangeAudience.description: The audience of the token a statement on Trino runs with: the caller's token is exchanged at the issuer (RFC 8693, by the client of keycloak.credentialsSecret) and forwarded only as a token of this audience. Empty: statements on Trino answer 400, sql-no-token-exchange (SQL_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_AUDIENCE).

secretStores.title: Secret stores
secretStores.description: The SecretStores the console creates in the projects' namespaces: one of kubernetes auth names the platform's Vault server or one of allowedServers.

allowedServers.title: Allowed Vault servers
allowedServers.description: Vault (OpenBao) server URLs allowed beside the platform's (SECRET_STORE_ALLOWED_SERVERS).

namespacePolicy.title: Namespace policy
namespacePolicy.description: A ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (Kubernetes >= 1.30) letting the server's ServiceAccount create only a Namespace labelled okdp.io/project with its name and a Pod Security level that is not privileged, and delete only a Namespace so labelled.
